# Everything improving is a warning

`customer_support.heu.queue_management.everything_improving_is_a_warning` · v1.0.0 · **draft** · scope **capability** · kind **heuristic**

> Every queue metric improving at once is a warning, not a win.


## The heuristic

**Every queue metric improving at once is a warning, not a win.**


_Why:_ Handle time, closes-per-agent and mean age all improve simply by working the easy tickets first. Genuine improvement almost always makes at least one number worse — usually handle time, because the hard ones finally got picked up.
